name: Bro Find AI

sources.title: Submit/Launch page — AI tool, agent, or MCP server launch: Free $0 launches go live ~3 months out (20 spots/week, hidden until Monday 00:00 UTC); Premium $17 one-time goes live immediately with always-dofollow link; free links nofollow unless the Bro Find AI badge is embedded

conditions: Free launch is real but gated twice: (1) a ~3-month queue — 20 free spots per week, hidden until your scheduled Monday 00:00 UTC; (2) free listing links are nofollow unless you embed the Bro Find AI badge on your site, which upgrades to dofollow while the badge stays up
requirements: Scope: AI tools, AI agents, and MCP servers only (700+ tools directory)
Sign-in required to submit ('Sign in and launch')
Required fields: site URL (icon pulled as logo), product name, tagline ≤80 chars, description ≤2000 chars
Optional: category, pricing, audience, tech details; FAQ/alternatives block for search/AI answers; a launch story
preparation: Decide free vs Premium ($17 one-time: live today, next week's board, gold ring, always-dofollow)
If staying free: be ready to wait ~3 months and optionally embed their badge for the dofollow upgrade
Optional streaks program: a comment or 3 upvotes daily — day 15 gets 50% off Premium, day 30 earns Premium free
workflow: Open https://brofindai.com/submit and pick launch type (AI tool / AI agent / MCP server)
Paste the site URL (duplicate check + auto logo), fill name/tagline/description, optional detail blocks
Choose Free (scheduled ~3 months out, countdown in My Dashboard) or Premium $17 (live immediately on next week's board)
Sign in and launch; edit/remove anytime from My Dashboard
Upvotes across the week pick the top 3 (winner medals); Premium pins above standard but can't buy rank
watchFor: The 'free' listing publishes months later — if you need launch-day timing, it's effectively $17
Free links are nofollow by default; the dofollow upgrade requires keeping their badge live on your site
Paid Premium does not buy ranking — pinned above standard but medals/rank still come from upvotes
Homepage ad spots are a separate product (/promote#ads)
Operator is a small India-based directory (contact is a gmail address)
countsAsLive: The launch goes live on the weekly leaderboard at the scheduled Monday 00:00 UTC (or immediately for Premium) and the product page exists on brofindai.com
unknowns: Actual free-queue wait beyond the ~3 months shown at time of check (depends on spot demand)
Traffic volume and upvote counts needed for the weekly top 3
